entries.name: 足尖朝前
entries.description: 站立时两脚掌大致平行，脚尖自然指向正前方，可作为比较内八字和外八字的基准。
entries.note: 用脚跟到前脚掌的长轴确认方向；两脚的趾形可以保留自然差异。

entries.name: 内八字
entries.description: 两脚的脚尖分别朝向身体中线，前脚掌比双脚跟更靠近。
entries.note: 从略高的视角比较两只脚的长轴，保留适度夹角和足尖间距。

entries.name: 外八字
entries.description: 两脚的脚尖分别朝向外侧，前脚掌之间的距离大于双脚跟之间的距离。
entries.note: 由脚跟向外确定脚掌长轴，两侧脚尖适度展开，保持足底自然贴地。

entries.name: 单脚外转
entries.description: 一只脚的脚尖朝前，另一只脚略向外侧，站立时两脚的朝向不对称。
entries.note: 分别定两只脚的长轴；换边时也要保留一前一外的差别。

boards.origin: AI 生成的原创站立足向对照图
boards.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a new 2×2 character-design atlas contact sheet for FOOT DIRECTION, using the attached LGT001 only as the rendering, skin tone and warm paper reference. Square canvas. Four separate equal SQUARE cells with straight subtle gray dividers at exactly x=50%, y=50%; no outside page margin, no headings. Each cell repeats the same high-front view looking down about 55 degrees at both lower shins and both bare feet of the same standing adult woman, cropped from mid-calf to floor, with visible flat dorsum, ankle attachment, and all toes. In every cell the body is facing the bottom edge of the page and the feet are naturally weighted on a flat warm off-white floor, heels at approximately the same hip-width spacing on a common horizontal baseline; only the direction of the foot long axes changes. The toe direction must be unambiguous from the silhouettes. TOP LEFT, label 'LGT017': both feet parallel, toes straight down toward bottom edge (↓ ↓). TOP RIGHT, label 'LGT018': BOTH feet slightly inward (about 20 degrees), image-left foot's toes point down-right toward the midline, image-right foot's toes point down-left toward the midline (↘ ↙), toe ends are closer together than heels, no overlap. BOTTOM LEFT, label 'LGT019': BOTH feet slightly outward (about 25 degrees), image-left foot points down-left, image-right foot down-right (↙ ↘), toe ends are farther apart than heels. BOTTOM RIGHT, label 'LGT020': only image-right foot turns down-right, image-left foot stays pointing straight down (↓ ↘), clearly asymmetric. Adapt the two ankles and lower shins coherently to the respective foot angles; no warped joints, twisted toes, crossed legs, raised heels, posed knee bends or duplicated/extra toes. In each foot the big toe is on the anatomical inner side. Keep all toe tips and both ankle silhouettes well inside each cell, with space below and around every foot. Same scale and perspective in all four cells, natural everyday angles rather than ballet turnout. Subdued semirealistic anime rendering on soft ivory like the reference. Small clear dark serif in each cell's upper-left corner, exactly LGT017, LGT018, LGT019, LGT020 respectively. No text or arrows except the four exact IDs.
